## Learnings

### Package specifics

- Current added package versions and important details: specmason 0.1.0 uses ledgerwerk/specmason and CLI specmason. reqledger 0.1.0 uses ledgerwerk/reqledger and CLI reqledger. documentledger 0.1.0 uses ledgerwerk/documentledger but installs CLI docledger, so meta.mainProgram and install checks must use docledger rather than documentledger. repairledger 0.1.0 uses holgern/repairledger and CLI repairledger. memoryledger 0.1.0 installs memoryledger and memledger CLIs, with memoryledger used as mainProgram. These packages are Apache-2.0 and belong in passthru.category = "Utilities".
- planledger 0.2.0 exists on PyPI, but nix-update did not detect it in this run. The normal fetchPypi source URL https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/planledger/planledger-0.2.0.tar.gz returned 404. Use the actual PyPI sdist file URL https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/6b/11/df972782b7ac047b10623521009dac4fd7daf359a4f90cd63bc359c31674/planledger-0.2.0.tar.gz with hash sha256-ZVM4m46W5Gs9VB90LVfiUDaaIUyJkDN1zEG2CMRIqyA=. The 0.2.0 metadata requires ledgercore<0.2,>=0.1.0 while this repo packages ledgercore 0.2.1, so packages/planledger/package.nix uses python3Packages.pythonRelaxDepsHook and pythonRelaxDeps = [ "ledgercore" ].

### Repository guidance

- Preserved repository guidance from the pre-memoryledger AGENTS.md: Project structure: root contains flake.nix, flake.lock, devshell.nix, README.md. Packages live under packages/<tool>/ with package.nix, default.nix, optional update.py, and lockfiles when needed. Formatting config is packages/formatter/treefmt.nix. Utilities and docs live in scripts/, docs/, and .github/. Build and development commands: enter the dev shell with nix develop. Build a package with nix build --accept-flake-config .#<package>. Run a package without installing with nix run .#<package> -- --help. Run repository checks with nix flake check. Format everything with nix fmt. Regenerate the README package section with ./scripts/generate-package-docs.py. Testing guidelines: build locally with nix build .#<package>. Run flake checks with nix flake check. Per-package checks can be built with nix build .#checks.$(nix eval --raw --impure --expr builtins.currentSystem).pkgs-<package>. For scripts, ensure shellcheck passes, and enable doCheck = true in packages when feasible. Commit and pull request guidelines: commit style mirrors history: <package>: summary. Version bumps use <package>: X -> Y (#123). New packages use <package>: init at X.Y.Z. PRs should include a clear description, rationale, testing notes, linked issues, and sample run output for CLIs. Before pushing, run nix fmt and nix flake check. Security and configuration tips: some tools are unfree, so enable unfree if needed in Nix config. Sandbox experiments are documented in packages/claudebox/. Pin sources with hashes and avoid network access at build time.

### Repository workflow

- When adding or updating packages in ledgerwerk.nix, use package directories under packages/<name>/ with default.nix calling ./package.nix and passing flake. Python CLI tools use python3Packages.buildPythonApplication with pyproject = true, fetchPypi or fetchurl, setuptools, setuptools-scm, and wheel. Runtime deps commonly include flake.packages.${stdenv.hostPlatform.system}.ledgercore plus typer, click, pyyaml, jinja2, markdown-it-py, and tomli as declared by upstream metadata. Regenerate README package docs with ./scripts/generate-package-docs.py, then run nix fmt and validate with nix flake check --accept-flake-config path:$PWD when new package directories are still untracked.
